spans.text: ## The 77 varieties, Pidgins and Creoles in the eWAVE sample
[The LanguageTable](languages.csv) provides an overview of the varieties, Pidgins and Creoles sampled in eWAVE and their distribution across variety types and world regions.

The information in the eWAVE database consists of judgements by top experts on each of the 77 varieties, Pidgins and Creoles on the frequency with which each of the 235 features can be encountered in the relevant variety, Pidgin, or Creole.

spans.text: ## The 77 varieties, Pidgins and Creoles in the eWAVE sample
[The LanguageTable](languages.csv) provides an overview of the varieties, Pidgins and Creoles sampled in eWAVE and their distribution across variety types and world regions.

The information in the eWAVE database consists of judgements by top experts on each of the 77 varieties, Pidgins and Creoles on the frequency with which each of the 235 features can be encountered in the relevant variety, Pidgin, or Creole.
